description: Page 06 canned chat (concept 06, Simulate > Propulsion simulation). Seeded through app_seed_thread in this order on the seeded research vehicle (fixtures/research-vehicle/seed.sh); the last thread is the one the capture opens. Three threads bound to the page (Tank motion 3m, Fin revision 1h, Flight comparison 2h; the rail sorts by recency). Tank motion mentions the demo engine's oxidizer tank (@Tank section), folds one simulate call of the Study 01 visual flow study (1 action · View step), and links the study's section view (render card rw:sim/study_01: opens Study 01 on the Visual flow tier with the section on; its picture is the live cutaway frame the tier caches). The Visual flow capture (capture/pages/06.ts) and the Engineering capture (06-engineering.ts) both open Tank motion; the numbers on the page come from the live runs, not from this file. Illustrative chat text, not engineering output.
